pages.label: Sales & Margin
pages.summaryPrompt: Write a concise executive summary of retail SALES and MARGIN for the current period. Cover net sales, gross margin and margin rate, the strongest and weakest departments, and the most significant year-over-year changes. Use specific numbers and keep it to a few short paragraphs.
suggestions: Net sales by department this year?
Which categories have the best gross margin?
Compare net sales this year vs last year by channel?

pages.label: Inventory & Promo
pages.summaryPrompt: Write a concise executive summary of PROMOTION and INVENTORY performance for the current period. Cover discount rate, promotional lift, sell-through and return rate, calling out the categories where promotions worked best and worst. Use specific numbers.
suggestions: What is the discount rate by department?
Which categories have the highest return rate?
